title: Bangsaen21 2026 Review: A Half-Marathon-Only Companion to Bangsaen42
seo_title: Bangsaen21 2026 Review | Bang Saen Beach, Chonburi
meta_description: Bangsaen21 2026 review: December 20 at Bang Saen Beach -- a single half-marathon event at Thailand's first purpose-built holiday resort.
dek: Set for 20 December 2026, this single-distance half marathon runs at Bang Saen Beach roughly five weeks after the Bangsaen42 full marathon covered elsewhere in this research -- two distinct events at the same historic resort.
verdict: Bangsaen21 is a companion event to the Bangsaen42 Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch -- same beach, same folklore-rich name origin, but a single-distance 21.098K half marathon rather than the full marathon/10K/half spread offered five weeks earlier. Together, the two races give Bang Saen Beach -- Thailand's first government-built holiday resort, dating to 1943 -- essentially two distinct running events across the December period. Registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: A Second Race at the Same Historic Beach
paragraphs: Bangsaen21 offers a single distance: the 21.098K half marathon, at Bang Saen Beach, Chonburi. [1] This is a separate event from the Bangsaen42 Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch, which offers 10K/21.1K/42K roughly five weeks earlier -- together the two races give Bang Saen essentially two distinct running events spanning the November-December period.

sections.heading: Thailand's First Purpose-Built Resort
paragraphs: Bang Saen Beach was the site of the Thai government's first purpose-built holiday resort, constructed in 1943. [2] The beach's name traces to local folklore about two tragic young Chonburi lovers, Saen and Sam Muk, whose story is woven into several nearby landmark names -- the same heritage detail covered at the Bangsaen42 review elsewhere in this research.

sections.heading: A Half-Marathon-Only Format
paragraphs: Unlike Bangsaen42's three-distance spread, this event offers just the half marathon -- a more focused format similar to Selangor Marathon's marathon/half-only approach covered elsewhere in this research. [1] That narrower focus suggests an event aimed at committed half-marathon runners specifically, rather than a broader multi-distance community race.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status has not been announced. [1] Given Bang Saen's proximity to both Bangkok and Pattaya, and the beach's genuine historical significance, demand could be reasonably strong once details firm up.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a focused half marathon at Thailand's historically significant first holiday resort -- especially if you're pairing it with or choosing it over the earlier Bangsaen42 full marathon -- Bangsaen21 on 20 December 2026 is a solid, single-distance pick. Watch official channels for registration to open.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Bangsaen42 Marathon?
faqs.answer: No -- they're separate events at the same beach roughly five weeks apart. Bangsaen21 offers only the 21.098K half marathon on 20 December 2026, while Bangsaen42 offers 10K/21.1K/42K distances earlier, on 15 November 2026. [1]

faqs.question: Why is Bang Saen historically significant?
faqs.answer: The Thai government built its first purpose-built holiday resort there in 1943. The beach's name comes from local folklore about two tragic young Chonburi lovers, whose story is tied to several nearby landmark names. [2]
